title: 6/11/2026 | Barbara J. Wright- Rosenkranz | PL | Copy to PUCT interchange of Another updated PUBLIC Letter of Protest sent to Governor Gregg Abbott on the PROCESS of THE TAKING 6-11-26, as going through trial.

=== Letter of Protest to Governor Gregg Abbott on the PROCESS of THE TAKING 6 11 26.pdf ===
PUBLIC Letter of Protest to Governor Gregg Abbott on the PROCESS of THE TAKING 6-11-26



Dear Governor Abbott,

Not knowing where to look, terms to use, and resources for help, this Pro Se Intervenor lodges
these complaints:

If I can I will attempt to add a photograph with this letter of our 1 and ½ inch stack of printed
out PUCT interchange filing receipts and legal pad of hand written notes.

We have barely been able to hang on through this tortuous process of the crime of owning
our own land and building it up by our own strength and the labor of love of our back and
arms, blood, sweat and tears. THAT IS OUR CRIME IN THIS TRIAL.

We set through conferences and pre-hearings trying to gather all that we could to PROTECT
OURSELVES and our FAMILY and our LAND. The microphones were low and hard to hear,
some of the information was mentioned quickly in passing – too quickly to catch it all, we
found ourselves asking each other, “what’d they say?” multiple times, or “what does that
mean?” multiple times.

The maps and information on the computer screen were impossible to read even if we were 1
inch from the computer screen, as even 1 Witness said so when he was asked to read the
screen.

We did and are to trying to do our due diligence in keeping up with all of this. But at every
level it seems we make some little error, through lack of clarity – that gets us kicked out of the
process. It was beginning to feel like we were targeted somehow. We didn’t understand that
until June 10, 2026 in listening to the Trial on the computer – the dark horse, the hidden ace
up the sleeve was revealed. The line, link, route that we are on, never before mentioned as a
‘favored link’, (only two others were ever mentioned, as I understand it the best I can, were
mention as also carefully considered by Witness Poole), (this information was pushed out by
several lawyers toward Witness Poole), but all the other confusing routes, and links that
distracted everyone from the target was brought forth to cause distraction. The target was
clear on June 10th, it was the hidden ace up the sleeve. Us. And we are being rushed
through, aren’t we. And our questions to the Applicant denied.

Somehow though we tried very hard, there was confusion on process, and time deadlines.
We were told we had to CAREFULLY, very CAREFULLY read the ALL SOAH’s. Over 30 of them.
All of them. Please sit down and do that, Governor Abbott. For us, it was confusing legalese,
and many (I don’t know what to call them), title, heading, resolutions; mention multiple
unclear issues, of which at least one we had to try to clarify through PUCT staff.
1
 We tried really hard to upload all of our information to THREE separate FILE SERVERS – PUCT
INTERCHANGE, KITEWORKS and EGNYTE. We did that, but it seems there was a SECOND lack
of understand and clarity on the deadlines (going through the trial), it seems some exhibits
are added in late in an arbitrary way being accepted, and some aren’t being accepted, into the
trial through an email, not sure.

However, because we kind of heard an ALJ wave off those EXHIBITS that were not added for a
reason of timeliness and/or not meeting some kind of vague expectations, though, it seems in
the watching, many things have been added in or some taken away, we are unclear as to why.
But it seems OUR RFI did not make it through, without clear reason, as we understand.

Our RFI – also called Discovery (we found out much later), was two questions: Preexisting
Corridors Preferred, and the 2nd was a clear graphic to scale grid comparison of maximum
height 765kv STEEL TRANMISSION Towers to an average size Texas Home. That was
something we could understand about the process, the size of it being truly represented.

These questions of ours were “kicked out”. Not really sure why. Our questions were different
than the ones we are hearing on the same issue, in the trial. But we did discover in the trial
through the Lawyers that Pre-existing Preferred Corridors in multiple terminologies, were the
“ace up the sleeve” so to speak as a hidden option against the other two ‘preferred routes.
This only came out after rapid, pointed questioning by a couple of ALIGNED GROUPS Lawyers.

It was an AHA MOMENT for me. All of this was a dog and pony show, a great distraction to
keep people busy and confused by multiple links and routes, and numbers and letters, and
processes, and arguments – to keep busy – while the real bandit snuck up behind us. Pro-Se-
INTERVENORS vs. ALIGNED powerful LAND owner GROUPS with POWERFUL LAWYERS, who
UNDERSTAND the TRIAL system – we PRO SE INTERVENORS do not understand the TRIAL
SYSTEM, 839 INTERVENORS being KICKED OUT. The target was the PREEXISTING CORRIDOR
all along. All the other confusion fell away.

The trouble is – I’ve found people in general, TEXANS, at large do NOT UNDERSTAND the
PREEXISTING CORRIDOR PREFERRED – that if we live by an large electric Pole – and its
brothers marching along the horizon – we are CONSIDERED – the PREFERRED TARGET for
continuing expansion of UTILITY TRANMISSION LINES, endless. I didn’t know that until I
accidentally came across the term in trying to understand this process.

Following this through – why would any person consider buying a property with a large
electrical power pole, with a possible future TARGET on its back? How will this knowledge, if
it becomes truly public impact property sales. One friend said, they’d lost the sale of a large
ranch property because of the threat of the 765kv and other lines. How will this impact
property values and tax base in the areas these monstrous towers are put.

2
 Which brings me to my SECOND DENIED QUESTION, or RFI or DISCOVERY. Why does ONCOR
LCRA ERCOT refuse to put out a public official to-scale-grid-comparison graphic between this
massive maximum height Electrified Steel Tower and the average Texas Home? Why?
Because if Texans saw the TRUE comparison – I do believe we would soundly reject the
proposal.

So, whether or not, this lack of confusion and clarity and problematic upsets, is accidental or
worse, the feeling is uneasy. The record shows the confusion and fuzziness of communication
and processes. There are not standardized forms, boxed in procedural dates sometimes do or
sometimes don’t include time deadlines, and very pertinent to the whole program of the
purpose of all of this - the TWO TARGETED RFI / DISCOVERY QUESTIONS to the APPLICANT
were rejected in fuzziness.

Yes, they had the terminology “Preexisting Corridors”, or “Parallel Lines”, or “Existing
Corridors”, or “Paralleling” [Corridors], (four different terms for the same thing), brought up in
trial, but nothing that we saw pointed to the IMPACT of PRE-EXISTING CORRIDORS on the entire
underbelly of the economics. Who wants to buy a home at full value that has is a PRE-EXISTING
TARGET on its back for MORE ugly towers full of trouble and ill health to invade upon. Common
sense – says – most likely few would pay the full value of a property destined to have huge steel
towers within 500 feet OR LESS in their back yard carrying billions of volts per day across the
backyard with MULTIPLES of MULTIPLES of problems – like corona discharge, buzzing,
interference, electric shock, wildfire risk, lightning strike increase risk and on and on and on –
lets alone its UNSIGHTLY TERROR!

They can say what they want and they will. But the fact of the matter is that THE PROCESS IS
THE TAKING – and WE ARE THAT TARGET, we finally understood that June 10th, 2026. STOP THIS
THING NOW, GOVERNOR ABBOTT before its too late for TEXAS!

We loved you and were really proud of you, Governor Abbott.

But not anymore.

Sincerely, Barbara Wright – Rosenkranz ETUX




3
